$comment: The retry table of contract 02 §4.1, as data. Each outcome row gives, per route class (routes.json), `retry` or `raise`. A retry is bounded by max_retries and waits per defaults.json `backoff`, unless a Retry-After of at most `retry_after_cap_seconds` is present, which wins. Rows are checked in order and the first match decides. Normative: an SDK whose decision differs from this table has a bug.

outcomes.description: The request provably never reached the server: connection refused, DNS failure, connect timeout.
The request may have been processed: read timeout, connection reset after send, a 502 from a proxy in front of the server, or a 408 from one that gave up waiting for the server.
notes: billed: the error carries reached_server=True (Python) / reachedServer: true (JS), and its message says a charge may have happened.
keyed: the retry resends the same Idempotency-Key, so the server recognises the repeat.

outcomes.description: 429 with a Retry-After of at most retry_after_cap_seconds, or none.
429 with a Retry-After above retry_after_cap_seconds. Raised at once with the value attached; never slept through.
Deterministic answers: repeating the request cannot change them. credits.unknown_action is a 500, but the server has no price for the action, which will not fix itself.
500 with any code except credits.unknown_action. A billed route charges as its last step, so its error is all but always uncharged, and the retry resends the same Idempotency-Key.
503 and 504. Answered before any charge, so a retry cannot pay twice.
